title: 初一五组十七题：手作伙伴与新老师
instruction: 阅读A—E五组中的全部九份文字材料，回答第1至第17题；每题从A、B、C、D四个选项中选出最合适的一项。各题2分，共34分。人物与事件均为虚构。
source_notice: 参照既存公开转载合肥三十中2025—2026七上10月卷阅读第一节A—E：A四份人物短介绍、B两封往返信、C一份场所与失物介绍、D个人活动介绍、E介绍另一人物；3/4/4/3/3共17题，各四独立候选，每题2分共34分。原总阅读20题40分另含第二节F三开放题，本稿不恢复开放部分，不称40分整大题。原A下划线未保于公开文字、E反向题未述信息风险及原键未取得分层保留；原校施测未独立认证。本稿所有人物机构、物品与活动虚构，A标粗代词及C标粗语境词在原创新材料明确显示，E反向项由原文明确否定，不把未述直接当错。全部九份文字与17题必须一起读答，不用单篇或固定六题抵数；作者自审不替代独立教研、学生、商用与生产验证。

sections.label: A
units: I am Amy. This is my little green notebook. I write animal names in **it**. The first page is about ducks.
Hi, I am Ben. My blue pencil case is on my desk. I keep two black pens inside.
I am Cara. My yellow bag has a picture of a rabbit. Yellow is my favourite colour.
Hello, I am Dan. I like yellow, too. My new ruler is yellow, but my schoolbag is brown.

sections.label: B
units:
Dear Tom,

My name is Ella. I am in Class Two at River School. I like making paper animals. I go to the craft club every Wednesday. My favourite colour is purple. Would you like to be my pen friend? I hope we can share our ideas.

Ella

Dear Ella,

Thank you for your letter. I am happy to be your pen friend. My favourite colour is green. I draw animals at the art club on Mondays. I do not make paper animals yet. Perhaps you can show me an easy one.

Tom

sections.label: C
units:
This is our school art room. There are four large tables for students and one small white desk for Mr Reed. He keeps paper on that desk. Students use the large tables for drawing and model making.

This morning, Lucy found a red pencil case under a chair. Mr Reed put it in the drawer of his small desk. There are three pencils and a blue rubber inside. There is no name on it. If it belongs to you, please **collect** it from Mr Reed after lunch. It will stay in the drawer until its owner comes.

sections.label: D
units:
My name is Oscar. I am twelve and I am in Class Four. I like drawing, but my favourite activity is making models. I make small boats from paper at home. My sister enjoys drawing more than making things.

Saturday is my favourite day. In the morning, I go to the model club with my cousin. After lunch, we work on a boat together. On Sunday, I usually help Dad in the garden. I enjoy that too, but I always look forward to Saturdays most.

sections.label: E
units:
Let me introduce our new music teacher, Ms Green. She is thirty-one years old. She likes blue and often carries a blue music bag. On Tuesdays, she plays the piano at a community centre. She enjoys walking on Sundays and takes photographs of trees.

Ms Green teaches us songs, but she also asks us to listen to one another. She is patient when we find a song difficult. She does not run the school football club; Mr Hill does that. We are glad to have her at our school.

questions.stem: A组 · What does the bold word “it” in A1 refer to?
questions.rationale: A：A1未述桌，写在笔记本非桌内；B：鸭是第一页主题，不是用来写字的容器；C：Amy在绿色笔记本里写动物名，it回指notebook；D：包在Cara介绍里，不是Amy写字的对象

questions.stem: A组 · What colour are Ben’s pens?
questions.rationale: A：Ben明确two black pens；B：绿为Amy笔记本；C：蓝是笔袋而非笔；D：黄色为其他人的包或尺

questions.stem: A组 · What can we learn from A?
options: Cara and Dan both like yellow.
questions.rationale: A：Dan尺黄但书包棕；B：Amy写动物名，第一页鸭，非只写植物；C：Ben有两支，非三支；D：Cara最喜欢黄，Dan说也喜欢黄

questions.stem: B组 · What is Ella’s favourite colour?
questions.rationale: A：Ella信中明确purple；B：白是C组桌子，与Ella无关；C：棕为Dan书包，非Ella偏好；D：green为Tom最喜欢

questions.stem: B组 · What does Ella like making?
questions.rationale: A：未做木椅，材料和对象不合；B：音乐袋在E组非Ella制作；C：Ella说喜欢做纸动物；D：没有制作花园门情节

questions.stem: B组 · When does Tom go to the art club?
questions.rationale: A：Tom每周一在美术社画动物；B：周日为其他人物活动；C：周三为Ella手作社；D：周二是E组老师弹琴

questions.stem: B组 · Why does Ella write to Tom?
options: To invite him to teach music.
To ask for a yellow ruler.
To ask him to be her pen friend.
To thank him for a boat.
questions.rationale: A：Tom是同龄笔友，未邀教音乐；B：没有索要尺子；C：信中直接邀请成为笔友分享想法；D：信中没有收到船或为船致谢

questions.stem: C组 · What colour is Mr Reed’s desk?
questions.rationale: A：未说老师桌绿；B：small white desk明确；C：蓝为笔袋里橡皮；D：红是失物笔袋

questions.stem: C组 · Where is the pencil case now?
questions.rationale: A：学生大桌未放此物；B：找到后移到老师小桌抽屉；C：Lucy找到后交老师，未留书包；D：那是发现时地点，之后移走

questions.stem: C组 · What is inside the pencil case?
options: Three pencils and a red rubber.
Three pencils and a blue rubber.
Two pens and a yellow ruler.
A notebook and a blue pen.
questions.rationale: A：铅笔数对但橡皮颜色错；B：内物明确三铅笔一蓝橡皮；C：这是干扰组合，原文非这些物品；D：未列笔记本与蓝笔

questions.stem: C组 · What does “collect” in C mean in Chinese?
questions.rationale: A：失主午饭后从老师处拿回自己的笔袋；B：笔袋已存在，非现场制作；C：请失主取回，非让失主藏起；D：归还失物非卖货

questions.stem: D组 · Which class is Oscar in?
questions.rationale: A：没有说Oscar一班；B：Oscar开头明确四班；C：两班为Ella；D：没有说Oscar六班

questions.stem: D组 · What is Oscar’s favourite activity?
questions.rationale: A：喜欢画画但更爱模型；B：摄影在E组老师介绍中；C：弹琴是Ms Green活动；D：明说最爱制作模型

questions.stem: D组 · Which day does Oscar like best?
questions.rationale: A：虽享受帮爸爸，但明确周六更喜欢；B：周一非其最爱日；C：周三为Ella社团，不是Oscar；D：开头该段和末句均强调周六最期待

questions.stem: E组 · How old is Ms Green?
questions.rationale: A：E开头31岁；B：多十岁，不符原数；C：少十岁，不符原数；D：30非31

questions.stem: E组 · Which statement about Ms Green is NOT true?
options: She is patient with the class.
She plays the piano on Tuesdays.
She runs the school football club.
questions.rationale: A：歌曲难时耐心明确支持；B：周二社区弹琴明确支持；C：文中明确她不负责足球社，由Mr Hill负责，直接矛盾；D：周日步行明确支持

questions.stem: E组 · What is the best title for E?
questions.rationale: A：只否认管足球社，未写比赛；B：失物在C，E非寻物启事；C：堂亲船在D，非E主旨；D：全文介绍新音乐老师背景与教学

format_summary: 完整客观第一节A—E / 9份文字 / 响应3+4+4+3+3=17 / 各4选 / 每题2分共34分 / 原第二节开放题暂停
